items.title: Lew Tabackin interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999

ctx.x: I mean that was like a very great learning experience, there was so much integrity in that. I never experienced that when the band moved to California. And then also it led to other gigs, like I did some work on the Dick Cavett show, because you meet different people. So all of a sudden, but it’s possible that I might have done a gig with them, although I wasn’t a regular member of the Tonight Show band at the time. It’s possible. You would have noticed because I was like much younger than any of those guys in…
Yeah. I’m pretty sure you were there, and I know it could have been a sub situation but I remember Jerry Dodgion.
Oh wait, that wasn’t the Tonight Show band.
